title: This is Exhausting
subtitle: Trying to keep up with 2024 is a bit much...
text: The Frontier Psychiatrists is a daily health-themed newsletter. On the weekends, I try to take it easy, because people don't read things as much. I try to write things that are more general interest, or a little bit weirder, knowing that they're not that important. Nothing on a Sunday does as well—numbers wise— as something similar on a Monday. It migh…
